scope: Core local-browser acceptance completed for both installed original editions. Original binaries execute mechanics; complete campaigns, every system, and media fidelity remain unverified.

mainMenu.detail: Both editions reached their native menus on the selected repaired JIT. Alien Crossfire also reached its menu on the untouched interpreter.

newGame.detail: Alien Crossfire Quick Start founded Alpha Prime (interpreter); clean-profile base Alpha Centauri Quick Start generated a Gaian world and accepted keyboard naming of browser gaia (repaired JIT).

baseManagement.detail: Opened original base control interface with nutrients, minerals, energy, allocation, and production.

unitMovement.detail: Alien Crossfire scout moved with ArrowLeft from (45,25) to (43,25) after native reload. Base Alpha Centauri scout moved northeast with PageUp to (73,55). Both reveal terrain outside the base.

endTurn.detail: Both repaired-JIT worlds advanced from Mission Year 2101 / Energy 11 to 2102 / Energy 12 after unit actions. Independently, the earlier disjoint-JIT run advanced a turn through Turn Complete and its unmoved-units confirmation.

nativeSave.detail: Alien Crossfire interpreter created a 2101 native save through Game > Save Game. Repaired JIT: Ctrl+S opened the native Save dialog in both editions and Enter created a 2102 save in each. Exported files match in-browser SHA256.

nativeSavePersistenceAndExport.detail: Closed Chromium, reopened same browser profile on focus candidate, downloaded the game-created save. SHA256 matches bytes written before process restart.

nativeLoadAfterRestart.detail: Fully closed Chromium after native 2101 save, restarted same browser profile using repaired JIT, exported byte-identical save, selected it in native Load Game, accepted Aki Zeta-5 / 2101 confirmation, and restored Alpha Prime, Scout Patrol, map, and Energy 11. Subsequently moved scout and saved 2102. This round trip crosses interpreter to repaired-JIT emulator modes.

audio.detail: AudioWorklet initialized at22050Hz stereo and original WAV resources opened; audible correctness was not evaluated in headless testing.

movies.detail: All installed movie assets included; opening movie disabled by copied compatibility INI.

baseEdition.detail: Separate clean browser profile, terran.exe on repaired JIT: native menu, new Gaian game, keyboard base naming, scout movement, year 2102, native save and export. Native reload of this separate base-edition save was not exercised.

browserSaveImportUI.detail: Real pre-existing save import/download/reload preserves SHA256; two invalid headers rejected. This separate test did not start the native game.

keyboard.detail: Base edition: ArrowDown menu selection, Enter Quick Start, base-name typing, Enter founding, diagonal movement. Both editions: Ctrl+S and Command+S opened native save dialog; Escape returned to world. Wrapper forwards shortcuts only when game canvas has focus.

baseEditionNativeReload.detail: Full native restart/load acceptance used Alien Crossfire; base edition save creation/export were tested separately.

prescribedSkillClient.detail: Exact local copy of prescribed develop-web-game Playwright client ran after final player changes; verifies wrapper ready state, selected engine, diagnostics and no console error before native Start. Native acceptance uses the persistent probe separately.

wholeCampaign.detail: No complete campaign, victory, every-faction or every-mechanic regression test.

multiplayer.detail: Networking is disabled in the local runtime configuration.

otherBrowsersAndMobile.detail: Acceptance ran on headless Playwright Chromium on macOS arm64.

startupTiming.interpretation: ~6m24s to title resource; menu only confirmed by later screenshot. Diagnostic file logging and concurrent local work were active.

limitations: Complete campaigns, victories, every faction/mechanic, multiplayer, other browsers, and mobile have not been validated.
Opening movies are disabled in copied INI; asset inclusion does not establish every codec or audible correctness.

Official untouched JIT failed code invalidation, and pinned X11 focus prevented keyboard use. Selected emulator includes documented local fixes; these tests do not establish universal emulator correctness.
Native save/reload after process restart was validated in Alien Crossfire across interpreter and repaired JIT. Base edition native save/export passed; its separate native reload was not exercised.
Startup remains multi-minute and host dependent; wrapper Runtime active does not imply native menu readiness.
cleanup: Owned runtime probe browsers/processes closed after capturing evidence; local static server left running.
